narrative.overview: The page is one document: a passport booklet for an engineer whose work crosses borders. Every section is a page of that booklet — a running head with a page number, not a card floating on a canvas. The ground is warm security paper with a faint burgundy guilloché watermark; identity lives in a burgundy cover band; and every role, market, and skill arrives as an ink stamp, pressed once, in one of four ink colors, multiplied into the paper so the ink reads as absorbed, never pasted. The system refuses the AI-default portfolio: no centered headings over rounded soft-shadow cards, no blue accent, no gradient decoration, no dark mode. Depth comes only from overlap — stamps crossing document edges — and from ink density.
keyCharacteristics: One document, paginated: running heads like 'Page 03 · Entries' on every section
Ink stamps as the only emphasis device, mix-blend-multiply, no fill behind them
Machine lines: all data, dates, and fields set in mono tabular caps
Engraved uppercase display lettering for names and headings
Flat square document corners; ovals belong to stamps only

rules.name: The One Document Rule
rules.body: The whole page is one booklet. Sections are pages with a running head and page number; a section that looks like a standalone card on a canvas has left the system.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Stamps and endorsement chips are pure ink on the page ground: mix-blend-multiply, no background fill, opacity 0.87–0.94 varying by ink. Ink never sits on a card.

rules.name: The Machine-Line Rule
rules.body: Data is always mono tabular caps — fields, periods, stamp text. Body prose is always the sans. A date set in the body face is a defect.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing blurs, nothing gradients, nothing glows. If depth is needed, overlap an ink element over a paper one.

dos: Do set every new section as a booklet page: running head, 2px rule, page number.
Do carry emphasis only through stamps and ink color; keep the ground and cards quiet.
Do keep motion to one settle per element on first view, transform-only, from a visible default.
Do use mono tabular caps for anything a machine would have printed.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glass, blur decoration, or shadows on resting elements.
Don't put a background fill behind stamps or endorsement chips.
Don't round document corners; ovals are for stamps only.
Don't add eyebrow labels above headings; the heading carries its own weight.
